messages:
alex kim: @incident-bot page fired for model-catalog-service - multiple 500s reported
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident INC-202603 triggered: model-catalog-service /models/resolve returning 500 (severity: P1)
pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: Incident INC-202603 - triggered by monitoring
maria gonzalez: ack. joining call. what components are failing and any known customers impacted?
jun park: dashboards show error rate spike ~12% for model-resolve calls, latency up ~3x. some customers reported failed inits with 500s.
sarah li: observed a bunch of "revision-not-found" errors targeting rev "rev-2026-q4" on ~30% of hosts. root seems related to recent catalog promotion.
alex kim: preliminary logs show variant metadata mismatch after promotion: a quantized variant labeled compatible with fleet runtime but using an older runtime_compat tag -> decode failures.
maria gonzalez: can someone paste the promoted config blob?
jun park: copying the blob we promoted:
```
model_id: rdw-bert-xl
revision: rev-2026-q4
variants:
  - id: v1-quant
    quant_profile: aggressive
    runtime_compat: 1.3.2
  - id: v1-fp16
    quant_profile: default
    runtime_compat: 1.4.x
```
sarah li: fleet is on runtime 1.4.1. runtime_compat 1.3.2 on the quant variant explains binary incompatibility and 500s.
alex kim: also looks like the variant fallback flag was left unset (false), so automatic fallback to fp16 didn't occur. customers pinned to the broken revision saw failures.
maria gonzalez: action: perform emergency rollback to previous stable revision rev-2026-q3, and in parallel apply a temporary route override to safe variant. jun, can you start rollback?
jun park: invoking rollback API:
```
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' https://console.redwood.ai/catalog/rollback -d '{"model_id":"rdw-bert-xl","target_rev":"rev-2026-q3","reason":"prod 500s"}'
```
incident-bot: Rollback job queued (job_id: rb-9876). estimated completion ~30s.
alex kim: additionally add route override: divert all traffic for rdw-bert-xl to rdw-bert-xl:v1-fp16 until rollback completes. maria please approve.
maria gonzalez: approved. applying override.
jun park: route override applied: `route: models/rdw-bert-xl -> rdw-bert-xl:v1-fp16 (100%)`
incident-bot: Rollback job rb-9876: succeeded. catalog now points rdw-bert-xl -> rev-2026-q3.
sarah li: monitoring: error rate falling back to baseline, latency returning to normal.
alex kim: good containment. next steps: 1) prevent promotions with runtime_compat mismatches by validating against fleet; 2) require explicit fallback flag on variants; 3) add staged promotion dry-run that touches small % of serving fleet.
maria gonzalez: opened post-incident ticket INC-202603-postmortem with owners eng-runtime + eng-oncall. priority: high.
jun park: I'll draft a short customer-facing note for impacted accounts and loop in support.
sarah li: handoff: alex you'll own monitoring for 2h?
alex kim: confirmed. watching metrics and logs. will escalate if anything recurs.
maria gonzalez: resolving PagerDuty incident. PagerDuty: Incident INC-202603 resolved by maria gonzalez
pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-202603 resolved
alex kim: thanks all for fast turnaround :thumbsup: please update the postmortem with timeline and any follow-ups.
